statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness consistent with supraventricular tachycardia
These episodes have become more frequent despite current medical management
The patient has a significant history of transient ischemic attack and cerebral infarction
Prolonged cardiac rhythm monitoring is clinically indicated to evaluate for potential arrhythmic triggers and guide further therapeutic intervention
The procedure code billed is CPT 93271
The diagnosis codes are I47.1 and Z86.73
The denial reason code is PR-204
The denial is based on the service not being covered under the member's current benefit plan
